returns: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Once we receive the item, refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.
shipping: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. Orders placed before 2pm ship the same day. You'll get a tracking number by email once your order ships.
sizing: Our clothing runs true to size. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up. Shoes follow standard US sizing. Free size exchanges are available within 30 days.
refunds: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive your returned item. You'll get an email confirmation when the refund is sent.
payment: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay. Your card is only charged when your order ships.
